**Exploring gossip terminology**

I’m thinking about "Chinese whispers" or the gossip that spreads through groups. It reminds me of the "telephone game" with its hidden answers. There are terms like "water cooler gossip," though I'm not sure what that means. I also considered "Gossip Girl" as a title reference. I'm considering various terms: "hearsay," "scuttlebutt," or "tittle-tattle" might fit too. I really want to connect terms without repeating similar ideas!
